# Support & Questions

If you need help, have questions, or want to discuss .NET/C# topics:

- Open a [question issue](https://github.com/cuthanhcam/learn-dotnet/issues/new?template=question.md)
- Start a GitHub Discussion (if enabled)
- See the docs/ folder for guides and notes
- Contact the maintainer: [cuthanhcam](https://github.com/cuthanhcam)
